objective:
[S-PROBE] Extraction feasibility spike — falsify SAEOS-1 §9/A8 before building. Deliverables: reviews/spikes/sakg-s1-extraction-probe.md — for each of 3 real sealed goals from ledger/ + reviews/tasks/, a hand-extraction attempt into the SAEOS-1 §4.3 node types, recording per-field: extractable / partial / absent. Explicit verdict GO or NO-GO with the loss ratio.
. Accept: ['test -f reviews/spikes/sakg-s1-extraction-probe.md', "rg -q '^verdict: (GO|NO-GO)$' reviews/spikes/sakg-s1-extraction-probe.md", "test $(rg -c '^## goal: ' reviews/spikes/sakg-s1-extraction-probe.md) -ge 3", "rg -q '^loss_ratio: 0\\.[0-9]+$' reviews/spikes/sakg-s1-extraction-probe.md"]

[F-ENVELOPE] Freeze the universal node envelope schema + fixture corpus. Deliverables: sakg/schema/envelope.schema.json (JSON Schema, draft 2020-12) covering every §4.2 field; tests/sakg/fixtures/envelope/{valid,invalid}/*.json exercising every field, every status value, and every §4.2 invariant violation (authored confidence, frequency-based promotion, deleted node).
. Accept: ['uv run python -c "import json,pathlib;json.loads(pathlib.Path(\'sakg/schema/envelope.schema.json\').read_text())"', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_envelope_schema.py -q', 'test $(ls tests/sakg/fixtures/envelope/valid/*.json | wc -l) -ge 12', 'test $(ls tests/sakg/fixtures/envelope/invalid/*.json | wc -l) -ge 8']

[G-S1-GO] FOUNDER GATE: A4 go/no-go on the S1 build, on S-PROBE evidence. Deliverables: A recorded founder decision (ledger entry) — PROCEED or REVERT — citing the S-PROBE loss ratio.
. Accept: ["rg -q 'SAKG-1/G-S1-GO' ledger/decisions/*.md", "rg -q '^decision: (PROCEED|REVERT)$' ledger/decisions/SAKG-1-G-S1-GO.md"]

[F-BUNDLE] Freeze the Emission Bundle contract + golden serialization bytes. Deliverables: sakg/schema/bundle.schema.json — the append-only outbox record emitted at L15/L16, carrying Decision, TradeOff, Option (including rejected), Constraint, Component, Scar, EvidenceRef. Golden JCS bytes + SHA-256 for each fixture. Explicitly forbids inline evidence payloads (§3.3.3).
. Accept: ['uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_bundle_schema.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_bundle_golden_bytes.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_bundle_forbids_inline_evidence.py -q']

[F-EXTRACT-FIX] Golden extraction fixtures — sealed PAEOS goal → expected bundle. Deliverables: tests/sakg/fixtures/extract/<goal_id>/{input/,expected_bundle.json} for the 3 S-PROBE goals plus 2 adversarial cases (a remanded goal; a goal whose L06 matrix is absent).
. Accept: ['test $(ls -d tests/sakg/fixtures/extract/*/ | wc -l) -ge 5', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_extract_fixtures_wellformed.py -q']

[I-STORE] Implement the SAKG graph store — append-only nodes, edges, supersession. Deliverables: sakg/store.py — node + edge persistence honouring the §4.2 envelope; append-only (no delete, supersession only); namespace isolation at the storage boundary; the 8 §4.4 edge families with edge-as-object properties. Registers `sakg` in pyproject [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel].packages.
. Accept: ['uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_store.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_store_append_only.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_store_namespace_isolation.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_edge_families.py -q', 'uv run ruff check sakg/', 'uv run pyright sakg/']

[I-OUTBOX] Implement the PAEOS-side post-seal outbox writer (L15/L16). Deliverables: runtime/emission/outbox.py — append-only bundle writer invoked at L15/L16 after seal. MUST NOT import `sakg`. MUST be a no-op when the goal did not reach `integrated`.
. Accept: ['uv run pytest tests/runtime/test_outbox_append_only.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/runtime/test_outbox_noop_unless_sealed.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/runtime/test_outbox_post_seal_ordering.py -q', "! rg -q 'import sakg|from sakg' runtime/", 'uv run pyright runtime/emission/']

[I-EXTRACT] Implement PAEOS artifact → typed node extractors. Deliverables: sakg/extract.py — L06 matrix → TradeOff; L04 candidates → Option (incl. rejected); L08 design set → Component; L11 contract → Constraint; decision-graph → Decision; scar-graph → Scar; CAS hashes → EvidenceRef. Unextractable fields are recorded as explicit gaps, never silently dropped.
. Accept: ['uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_extract.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_extract_golden.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_extract_records_gaps.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_extract_rejected_options_retained.py -q', 'uv run pyright sakg/']

[I-INGEST] Implement pull-based ingest — outbox → candidate nodes in namespace. Deliverables: sakg/ingest.py — reads the outbox, writes nodes at status=candidate in the producing project's namespace, idempotent on re-read.
. Accept: ['uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_ingest.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_ingest_idempotent.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_ingest_lands_candidate_only.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_promotion_requires_evidence_binding.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_frequency_never_promotes.py -q']

. Accept: ['uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_roundtrip.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_roundtrip_property.py -q', 'uv run python -m sakg.report roundtrip --assert-loss-ratio 0']

[F-PROJ] Freeze the Projection Request/Response contract + fixtures. Deliverables: sakg/schema/projection.schema.json — request (method, subject, namespace, budget{max_tokens,max_nodes,tier}, filters{min_confidence,as_of,status}) and response (results[{node_summary,score,why}], provenance{sakg_version, corpus_hash,query_hash}, truncated, omitted, trust, tier). `trust` is the constant "untrusted"; `tier` never admits FULL.
. Accept: ['uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_projection_schema.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_projection_trust_constant.py -q', 'uv run pytest tests/sakg/test_projection_rejects_full_tier.py -q']
